payment.title: Payment
payment.none: No online payment. The order is settled outside the platform (e.g. invoice and bank transfer).
payment.simulatedNote: Test payment – no real money is moved.

buyer.optional: Online payment is optional. Alternatively settle the order as agreed by invoice or bank transfer outside the platform.
buyer.escrowNote: The amount is held by the payment provider and released to the seller only after the inspection period (or once you accept the goods). If the order is cancelled or rejected, the amount is refunded automatically.
buyer.openText: The payment was started but not completed. Continue it with the payment provider.
buyer.failedText: The last payment was not successful. You can try again.
buyer.refundPendingText: The order has been refunded. The online payment will be paid back automatically shortly.

seller.pending: Paid out once the order is completed (after the inspection period or the buyer's acceptance).
seller.processing: Order completed – the payout is being processed.
seller.refunded: The amount was refunded to the buyer – no payout.
seller.onHold: The buyer reported a problem – the payout is on hold until the complaint is resolved.
seller.refunding: Refund granted to the buyer – the online payment is paid back automatically, no payout.

disputes.textRequiredHint: Required. The text is shown to both parties in the conversation.
disputes.textOptionalHint: Optional. The text is shown to both parties in the conversation.

confirmText.refund: The buyer gets the full order amount back. An online payment is refunded automatically, the order is closed as "Refunded" and you receive no payout. This cannot be undone.
confirmText.withdraw: The complaint is closed without a refund. The order is completed and the seller is paid out. This cannot be undone.
confirmText.escalate: HandyNet reviews the case and makes a binding decision on a refund. Completion and payout stay on hold until then. You can still send messages.

explain.openBuyer: The seller has been notified. Settle the problem in the conversation. If you cannot agree, you can hand the case over to HandyNet.
explain.openSeller: The buyer reported a problem. Completion and payout are on hold until the complaint is resolved. You can grant a refund or hand the case over to HandyNet.
explain.escalated: The case is with HandyNet. The platform decides on a refund; the decision appears in the conversation.
explain.refunded: Complaint closed with a full refund (decided by: {by}).
explain.closedWithoutRefund: Complaint closed without refund (decided by: {by}). The order is completed.

form.title: Report a problem
form.holdNote: Submitting stops the automatic completion of the order and puts the seller's payout on hold until the complaint is resolved.
form.descriptionHint: Describe the problem as precisely as possible ({n}/{max} characters).

disputes.reported: Complaint for order {number} has been reported.
disputes.withdrawn: Complaint for order {number} has been withdrawn.
disputes.escalated: The case has been handed over to HandyNet.

lists.subtitle: Upload, review and publish monthly buyback price lists.
lists.label: Price list
lists.emptyText: Upload the first monthly price list.

upload.title: Upload a new price list
upload.rules: The list price is the reference price for condition "Good". New models, every increase and decreases of more than 30 % need approval; smaller decreases and unchanged prices are accepted automatically.
upload.fileHint: Excel workbook, max. 10 MB, max. 5,000 models.
upload.label: Label
upload.timezone: Dates and times are interpreted in your browser's time zone ({zone}).
upload.dateOrder: The end must be after the start.
upload.dateTooLong: A price list is valid for at most three months (92 days).
upload.done: Price list "{label}" was imported and awaits review.

rules.title: Approval rules
rules.new: New model (no previously published price) → approval required.
rules.largeDecrease: Decrease of more than 30 % → approval required.
rules.auto: Decrease of up to 30 % or unchanged price → accepted automatically.
rules.noCarryOver: Only the currently valid published list counts: models missing from it or whose price was rejected have no price – prices are never carried over from the previous month.

review.subtitle: Review price changes, approve or reject them and publish the list.
review.notInReview: The list is no longer in review.
review.pendingBlock: Publishing is possible once all {count} pending prices are approved or rejected.
review.readyToPublish: All prices are decided. The list can be published.
review.publishedText: This list is published. Its approved and automatically accepted prices are immutable.
review.discardedText: This list was discarded and is not used.
review.autoNotSelectable: Automatically accepted prices cannot be selected.
review.selectPage: Select all selectable entries on this page
review.publishText: {accepted} prices will be published as immutable price versions, valid from {from} until {until}.
review.publishWarning: Once this list is in effect, only it counts: models missing from it and the {rejected} rejected models will have no buyback price – nothing is carried over from earlier lists.
review.discardText: The list will not be published. This cannot be undone.

skipped.title: Skipped rows ({count})
skipped.hint: These rows had no usable price or no model. They get no price.

policy.subtitle: Versioned pricing policy: condition adjustments, deductions, margins. Every change creates a new immutable version.
policy.formHint: Values in percent with up to two decimals. The form starts from the active version.
policy.batteryThresholdHint: Deduction when the battery health is below this value.
policy.overridesHint: Model beats brand beats default. Brand: e.g. "Apple". Model: "Brand|Model|Storage", e.g. "Apple|iPhone 13|128 GB". Case, spaces, "-", "_" and "." are ignored.
policy.effectiveFromHint: Empty = immediately. Your browser's time zone ({zone}).
policy.invalidNumber: Please enter a number with at most two decimals.
policy.rangeThreshold: Please enter a whole number from 0 to 100.
policy.overrideDuplicate: There is already a row for this brand/model and condition.
policy.effectiveInPast: The time must not be in the past.

ankauf.searchHint: Only models with a currently valid price are shown.

ankauf.moreResults: At most 100 models are shown – please refine the search.

intake.marginScheme: Bought from a private person: resale under the margin scheme (§25a UStG).
intake.rejectHint: The device is not bought and is returned to the seller.

invoices.title: Commission invoices
invoices.subtitle: Invoices from HandyNet for the brokerage commission on online-paid sales, issued monthly after the month has ended.
invoices.hint: Invoice numbers HN-YYYY-nnnnnn, corrections HN-RK-YYYY-nnnnnn. Issued documents are never changed: if an already invoiced payment is refunded, an invoice correction in the month of the refund offsets the line.
invoices.emptyText: Invoices are issued after the end of a month for the sales paid online in that month.

detail.subtitle: The document exactly as issued. Issued invoices are never changed.
detail.serviceText: Brokerage commission for orders paid online via HandyNet, one line per order.
detail.correctionNote: This invoice correction reverses the following lines of invoice {number} because the payments were refunded.
detail.withheldNote: The commission was already withheld from the payout; no payment is due.
detail.placeholder: SAMPLE: the issuer data are still placeholders. This document is not a valid invoice.

admin.subtitle: Issue and review commission invoices and invoice corrections for a completed month.
admin.monthHint: Completed months only (German time). The previous month is suggested.
admin.autoHint: A background job issues the previous month automatically, normally in the first hour of the 1st. Here you can bill a month manually or catch up, e.g. after an outage.
admin.idempotentHint: Running it again is safe: at most one invoice is created per seller and month, and at most one correction per corrected invoice and refund month. Documents that already exist are returned unchanged and counted as "Already issued". After errors, simply run it again.
admin.correctionHint: Invoice corrections are created in the run for the month in which the refund happened, not the month of the original invoice.
admin.pdfHint: Sellers can download the PDFs under Finances → Invoices.
admin.confirmText: Invoices and invoice corrections for {month} will be issued for all sellers with commission or refunds. Issued documents are final and sequentially numbered; they cannot be changed or deleted.
admin.idempotentShort: Documents of this month that already exist are not issued twice.

outcome.unchanged: Nothing new: all documents of this month had already been issued.
outcome.empty: No sellers with commission or refunds in this month.
